testimonials.title: What our clients say about us

items.name: Sophie Margaret
items.title: An unforgettable trip thanks to Madabest!
items.content: My husband and I discovered Madagascar in a unique way. The Madabest team created a tailor-made tour perfectly adapted to our wishes: between nature excursions, cultural moments and paradise beaches, everything was perfectly organized. The guides were passionate, always available, and made us feel like friends rather than just travelers. A big thank you to the whole team for their professionalism and human warmth. We leave with extraordinary memories and the desire to return!

items.name: Jean Luc
items.title: An authentic and perfectly organized experience
items.content: I chose Madabest for my trip to Madagascar, and it was an incredible experience. The team took care of everything: from hotel choices to excursions, including car rentals, every detail was carefully prepared. I particularly appreciated the kindness of the guides and their knowledge of the country, which allowed me to discover places off the beaten path. I highly recommend Madabest to anyone who wants to explore Madagascar differently, with professional and warm service.

video.title: THE BEST EXCURSIONS
video.subtitle: Choose your pleasure vacation
video.description: Nosy Be, nicknamed "the island of perfumes", is one of the most popular destinations in Madagascar. Between its white sandy beaches lined with coconut trees, its turquoise waters ideal for diving and snorkeling, and its volcanic landscapes dotted with sacred lakes, the island offers unique diversity. You can discover small neighboring islands like Nosy Komba or Nosy Tanikely, admire unforgettable sunsets on Andilana beach, or stroll through the colorful markets of Hell-Ville.

title.full: General terms and conditions of reservation and cancellation

reservation.title: Reservation & Commitment
reservation.sidebarText: Reservation possible in office, by phone or email, confirmed by proforma invoice.

content.intro: **The reservation of a trip** or other services can be made at **our office**, **by phone** or always **confirmed by email**. Necessary and sufficient communications for listening and detailed understanding of each step, the itinerary and the course of your trip, as well as accommodations according to the chosen means and times, are essential. A proforma invoice will be sent to you upon confirmation of the service.
content.engagement: The commitment only takes effect upon receipt of the requested deposit.
content.address: 43 Rue de la marne – Diego Suarez

assurance.title: Insurance
assurance.sidebarText: Liability insurance included, additional travel insurance at your expense.

content.description: Our Madabest agency has taken out professional liability insurance with **NY HAVANA** company, covering risks related to the exercise of our activities. However, this coverage does not include medical evacuations, assistance insurance, cancellation or comprehensive travel insurance. We strongly recommend that each traveler takes out an appropriate insurance policy (medical assistance, repatriation, baggage loss, cancellation, etc.) with their usual insurer in order to travel with complete peace of mind.

prix.title: Price
prix.description: For invoice payments in Ariary, the rate will be calculated based on the euro exchange rate on the day the payment is made. The validity of the rates announced in the price reference or on our website is for the current year. In general, we mention the details of expenses included in the price. Tips and drinks are not included in the prices. Discounts on certain services are available for children under 10 years old.

reglement.title: Payment
reglement.sidebarText: A 20% deposit at booking, balance to be paid 30 days before departure.

content.deposit: A deposit of 20% of the service is requested to initiate the commitment and preparation of the trip/service. The balance is ideally payable 30 days before the start date of the trip or departure.
content.balance: and the preparation of the trip/service. The balance is ideally payable **30 days before the start date of the trip or departure**. We cannot guarantee the realization of the client's trip before the service payment is complete. **Payment can be made in Euro or Ariary by bank transfer**. It goes without saying that the fees related to the transfer will be borne by the client. A confirmation email from the client of the transfer or payment with a copy of the transfer order is requested. The account and bank number are communicated to you upon request.
